name: character-development
description:
Creates detailed, psychologically grounded character profiles with internal contradictions, behavioral patterns, and narrative function. Produces character bibles for fiction writing.
Use when the user asks to develop a character, create a character profile, build a character bible, or flesh out a fictional character.
Do NOT use for world-building (use world-building), dialogue craft (use dialogue-writing), or writing a complete story (use short-story-writing).
